title: Crispy Pork Stir Fry
description: A quick and delicious Chinese-inspired dish made with crispy pork and stir-fried vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the wok.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Return the pork to the wok and add the soy sauce.
Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the pork is coated in the sauce.
Brush the syrup over the pork and stir-fry for another minute.
